text: Running short on feathers? Craft eight feathers with an Analysis Crystal to make one Air Microcore. Craft that core with the crystal to get sixteen feathers back. You gain eight feathers and use two points of durability per cycle.
Earth, Water and Fire Microcores work the same way. Splitting them yields dirt, cod and coal respectively. Set some of the output aside for the next craft to keep early supplies topped up.

Light and Dark Microcores take four units of their respective material and return eight. Time and Space Microcores take three matching warp or fold points and return four. Omni Microcores cannot be cycled.

Once you have a Crystallized Philosopher’s Stone, use it in place of the Analysis Crystal at the crafting table. You can repeat both steps by hand to produce materials in bulk without wearing out the stone.
